components.description:
Wraps Angular Material's button family behind one design-system API.

Content is projected: <magic-button>Save</magic-button>. The label input is a fallback so <magic-button label="Save" /> also works.

  • kind switches between a regular, icon, FAB, mini FAB or extended FAB button.
  • variant maps to Material's matButton appearance.
  • color, size and shape are applied through theme tokens, not inline styles.

components.templateData:
<ng-template #body>
  @if (loading() && loadingLabel()) {
    {{ loadingLabel() }}
  } @else {
    <ng-content>
      @if (isIconOnly()) {
        <mat-icon aria-hidden="true">{{ leadingIcon() }}</mat-icon>
      } @else {
        {{ label() }}
      }
    </ng-content>
  }
</ng-template>

@switch (kind()) {
  @case ('icon') {
    <button
      matIconButton
      magicButtonBinding
      [disabled]="isDisabled()"
      [disableRipple]="disableRipple()"
      [disabledInteractive]="disabledInteractive()"
      [showProgress]="loading()"
    >
      @if (loading()) {
        <mat-progress-spinner
          progressIndicator
          mode="indeterminate"
          [diameter]="spinnerDiameter()"
        />
      }
      <ng-container [ngTemplateOutlet]="body" />
    </button>
  }
  @case ('fab') {
    <button
      matFab
      magicButtonBinding
      [disabled]="isDisabled()"
      [disableRipple]="disableRipple()"
      [disabledInteractive]="disabledInteractive()"
      [showProgress]="loading()"
    >
      @if (loading()) {
        <mat-progress-spinner
          progressIndicator
          mode="indeterminate"
          [diameter]="spinnerDiameter()"
        />
      }
      <ng-container [ngTemplateOutlet]="body" />
    </button>
  }
  @case ('mini-fab') {
    <button
      matMiniFab
      magicButtonBinding
      [disabled]="isDisabled()"
      [disableRipple]="disableRipple()"
      [disabledInteractive]="disabledInteractive()"
      [showProgress]="loading()"
    >
      @if (loading()) {
        <mat-progress-spinner
          progressIndicator
          mode="indeterminate"
          [diameter]="spinnerDiameter()"
        />
      }
      <ng-container [ngTemplateOutlet]="body" />
    </button>
  }
  @case ('extended-fab') {
    <button
      matFab
      extended
      magicButtonBinding
      [disabled]="isDisabled()"
      [disableRipple]="disableRipple()"
      [disabledInteractive]="disabledInteractive()"
      [showProgress]="loading()"
    >
      @if (loading()) {
        <mat-progress-spinner
          progressIndicator
          mode="indeterminate"
          [diameter]="spinnerDiameter()"
        />
      } @else if (leadingIcon()) {
        <mat-icon aria-hidden="true">{{ leadingIcon() }}</mat-icon>
      }
      <ng-container [ngTemplateOutlet]="body" />
    </button>
  }
  @default {
    <button
      [matButton]="variant()"
      magicButtonBinding
      [disabled]="isDisabled()"
      [disableRipple]="disableRipple()"
      [disabledInteractive]="disabledInteractive()"
      [showProgress]="loading()"
    >
      @if (loading()) {
        <mat-progress-spinner
          progressIndicator
          mode="indeterminate"
          [diameter]="spinnerDiameter()"
        />
      } @else if (leadingIcon()) {
        <mat-icon aria-hidden="true">{{ leadingIcon() }}</mat-icon>
      }
      <ng-container [ngTemplateOutlet]="body" />
      @if (trailingIcon()) {
        <mat-icon iconPositionEnd aria-hidden="true">{{ trailingIcon() }}</mat-icon>
      }
    </button>
  }
}

  <magic-text-input type="email" />
</magic-form-field>

See https://material.angular.dev/components/form-field/overview

    [variant]="buttonVariant()"
    [color]="buttonColor()"
    [size]="size()"
    [disabled]="disabled()"
    [loading]="loading()"
    [testId]="testId() ? testId() + '-submit' : undefined"
  />
</form>

    [hideSingleSelectionIndicator]="hideSingleSelectionIndicator()"
    [disableOptionCentering]="disableOptionCentering()"
    [typeaheadDebounceInterval]="typeaheadDebounceInterval()"
    [sortComparator]="sortComparator()!"
    [panelClass]="panelClass() ?? ''"
    [panelWidth]="panelWidth()"
    [canSelectNullableOptions]="canSelectNullableOptions()"
    [tabIndex]="tabIndex()"
    [compareWith]="compareWith()"
    [errorStateMatcher]="errorStateMatcher"
    (selectionChange)="onSelectionChange($event)"
    (openedChange)="onOpenedChange($event)"
    (blur)="onBlur()"
  >
    <mat-select-trigger>{{ triggerSummary() }}</mat-select-trigger>

    @for (group of optionGroups(); track group.label) {
      <mat-optgroup [label]="group.label" [disabled]="group.disabled ?? false">

      <mat-option [value]="option.value" [disabled]="option.disabled ?? false">
        {{ option.label }}

    }
  </mat-select>
</magic-form-field>

      (focusout)="touch.emit()"
    />
    <input
      matSliderEndThumb
      [value]="endValue()"
      (input)="onEndChange($any($event.target).valueAsNumber)"
      (valueChange)="onEndChange($event)"
      (focusout)="touch.emit()"
    />
  } @else {
    <input
      matSliderThumb
      [value]="value()"
      (input)="onSingleChange($any($event.target).valueAsNumber)"
      (valueChange)="onSingleChange($event)"
      (focusout)="touch.emit()"
    />
  }

Supports Signal Forms (FormValueControl), Reactive Forms (formControl / formControlName), Template-driven Forms ([(ngModel)]) and direct [(value)] binding.

See https://material.angular.dev/components/input/overview See https://angular.dev/guide/forms/signals/custom-controls

typealiases.rawdescription:
Maps a framework-agnostic props interface (from
`@mono-magic/atomic-design-interfaces`) onto its signal-based Angular
equivalent, so a component can say
`implements SignalProps<ButtonAtomProps>`.

Every prop must be exposed as a signal (`input()`, `model()`, `computed()`),
which keeps the Angular components honest against the shared contract.
